executionPolicy.interpretation: The plan organizes all missing integrations in one orchestration; it does not assert feasibility or completion in one ChatGPT response.

sharedGates.GATE-00-reconcile-clinical-backend-and-U: Reconcile stacked PRs #11–#20 with P06/P07 (#1–#10) without replacing parallel implementation; create tagged baseline and contract-diff report
sharedGates.GATE-01-verified-identity-and-tenant-cel: Production-capable OIDC MFA, session/revocation, tenant-cell mapping, patient/encounter authorization, scoped server credentials; no testing identity issuer in release
sharedGates.GATE-02-review-typed-domain-contracts: Canonical field dictionary and all read/write API contracts with exact roles, security, error states, events and migration ownership
sharedGates.GATE-03-db-and-outbox-concurrency: PostgreSQL RLS, scoped transactions, durable audit/outbox, idempotency and encrypted data; actual integration environment required
sharedGates.GATE-04-module-screen-evidence: Each of 240 screens passes all 14 done checks; no fake records or disabled placeholders counted
sharedGates.GATE-05-integration-and-release: Cross-module E2E, migration/failover/offline tests, rollback, security review; 21 existing partial screens and clinical certification separately reviewed

definitionOfDone: Canonical field dictionary (EN/FR, type, constraints, requiredness, code systems) approved
Typed OpenAPI request/response and error schemas reviewed with contract tests
Hospital-cell, tenant, facility, patient, encounter and role scope verified server side where applicable
Actual data access: transactional PostgreSQL/RLS read or atomic, idempotent command persistence as required
Workflow finite-state transitions, optimistic revision checks, conflicts and reversals implemented
Patient safety, consent, privilege, segregation-of-duties and maker/checker rules enforced
Audit provenance + transactional outbox/inbox events and event replay handling tested
Every screen control, tab, search/filter, field, validation, button and linked action wired
No fake patients/financial balances, unsafe shortcuts, PHI in browser storage, or unqualified clinical automation
Mobile 320/375/768 and desktop 1024/1440/1920 width, keyboard, focus, WCAG 2.2 AA audited; no glow/color collision/cramp
English/French translations, local formatting, loading/empty/error/offline/recovery states verified
Print/export/report/template issuance verified with authorization and integrity when in scope
Unit + integration + contract + adversarial security + Playwright E2E tests green against an actual test DB
Screen accepted by authorized business/clinical reviewer with evidence hash; otherwise stay blocked
